# Self-Check Checklist (auto-generated — DO NOT hand-edit)

Generated by pattern_extractor.py. Learning phase: 3
(phase 3: self-evaluating (4 high categories, 7 verified principles))

Run this checklist against the CURRENT treatment code BEFORE proposing any
change and AFTER applying one. Fix violations you find — even ones the user
did not mention this session.

- [HIGH] typography: verify all text elements in treatments.tsx have fontWeight >= 900 AND a visual effect (text-shadow/drop-shadow/gradient fill) ← 1 mention(s), bias: always prefer bold typography (900+) with visual effects (stroke/gradient/shadow)
- [HIGH] color: verify filter strings have saturate >= 1.0 and brightness >= 0.85; accents must pop against background ← 2 mention(s), bias: always prefer vivid, saturated colors with high contrast; never washed out or muted
- [HIGH] composition: verify major fills use linear-gradient/radial-gradient; connectors use curved paths, not straight lines ← 1 mention(s), bias: prefer gradients over flat fills; organic curves over mechanical straight lines
- [HIGH] narrative: verify information treatments have a narrative element (host presence, story arc) — flag as requires-design if not ← 1 mention(s), bias: present information as narrative (character/host tells the story), not raw data display
- [MEDIUM] motion: verify every element has purposeful animation (spring/interpolate, not static) ← 1 mention(s), bias: motion must serve the narrative; keep draw-on reveals and spring entrances

Categories not listed have no feedback evidence — use inherited principles
from taste-standard.md for them.
